## Runspur v0.1.1

Installer fix for the initial Windows x64 backend preview.

### Fixed

- Resolve the latest version using GitHub's public release redirect instead of the anonymous REST API. Installation no longer depends on the shared anonymous API quota.
- Support the redirect response shapes used by Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.

The scheduler features and experimental compatibility scope are unchanged from v0.1.0. CI and release jobs run the Rust checks and eight installation tests before publication.

### Install or update

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ohmacemace/runspur/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Close running Runspur programs before updating. No Rust, Node.js, or administrator access is required.

### Assets

- `runspur-v0.1.1-windows-x86_64.zip`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
- `install.ps1`

See the [README](https://github.com/ohmacemace/runspur#readme) for project setup and supported entrypoints.
